info.name: OpenShift REST API — Complete Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the OpenShift REST API.

## Setup
1. Set `oc_api_url` to your cluster API URL: `https://api.<cluster>.<domain>:6443`
2. Set `oc_token` by running: `oc whoami -t`
3. Set `namespace` to your target project
4. In Postman Settings > turn off SSL certificate verification (for self-signed certs)

## Token
After `oc login`, get your token:
```
oc whoami -t
```
Paste it in the `oc_token` variable.

## Notes
- port-forward and exec require oc/kubectl binary — not available via REST
- All secret values are base64 encoded
- OpenShift-specific resources use `apis/route.openshift.io`, `apis/apps.openshift.io`, etc.
